data.title: Marquis Horizon
data.about:
Marquis Horizon at Dubai South is a contemporary mid-rise residential address with a total of 175 thoughtfully designed homes. The project by Marquis Developers features 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, shaped by flowing architecture, climate-responsive design, and layouts that emphasize natural light, privacy, and everyday comfort within a growing urban district.

Positioned as a lifestyle-led development, Marquis Horizon by Marquis Developers integrates resort-inspired amenities such as an infinity pool, fully equipped gym, rooftop yoga deck, and open-air amphitheatre. Set within Dubai South’s long-term growth corridor, it presents strong capital appreciation potential driven by connectivity, evolving infrastructure, and rising residential demand.

characteristics_module.title: Marquis Horizon at Dubai South by Marquis Developers Redefines Contemporary Community Living
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Strategic Dubai South Location – Positioned within a high-growth district offering connectivity, future infrastructure, and long-term residential demand.
  • Efficient Apartment Collection – A focused mix of 1 and 2-bedroom residences designed for modern living and strong end-user appeal.
  • Resort-Style Amenities – Infinity pool, rooftop wellness zones, and social spaces elevate daily living beyond conventional residences.
  • Community-Centric Design – Open courtyards, amphitheatre, and shared spaces encourage interaction while maintaining privacy.
  • Developer-Led Vision – A landmark project reflecting Marquis Developers’ commitment to quality, planning, and future-focused communities.
  • Attractive Entry Pricing – Positioned competitively within Dubai South, supporting both lifestyle buyers and investment strategies.
  • Flexible Payment Options – Multiple structured plans including a post-handover option enhance accessibility and long-term investment value.
  • High Capital Appreciation Potential – Dubai South’s expanding infrastructure and demand dynamics reinforce long-term appreciation potential.

location_tile.title: Connected Living within Dubai South’s Emerging Residential Corridor
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Marquis Horizon by Marquis Development is located in Dubai South, offering direct access to Expo Road (E77) and Emirates Road (E611). The location places residents within a rapidly developing hub known for mobility, economic growth, and proximity to key destinations, supporting both lifestyle convenience and long-term investment potential.

  • 9 Minutes – Dubai Founders School
  • 20 Minutes – Dubai Investments Park
  • 20 Minutes – Expo City
  • 20 Minutes – Al Maktoum International Airport (DWC)
  • 24 Minutes – Circle Mall
  • 32 Minutes – Ibn Battuta Mall
  • 35 Minutes – Dubai Marina
